PERSONAL AUTO POLICY - DECLARATIONS
Policy Number: PA-100053
Named Insured: Marcus T. Hale
Policy Period Start: 10/27/2026
Policy Period End: 10/27/2027
Continuous Coverage Since: 03/07/2008
Covered Vehicle: 2023 Hyundai Elantra SEL, VIN 8HT7AFTNR9KUVVKEJ
Bodily Injury Liability Limit: $25,000 each person / $50,000 each accident
Property Damage Liability Limit: $100,000 each accident
Uninsured/Underinsured Motorist Limit: $100,000 each person / $300,000 each accident
Medical Payments Limit: $1,000 each person
Collision Deductible: $2,000
Comprehensive Deductible: $250
Rental Reimbursement: $40 per day / $1,200 maximum
Total Policy Premium: $881.95

POLICY TERMS

SECTION 2.1 - Liability Coverage
We will pay damages for bodily injury or property damage for which an insured is legally responsible because of an auto accident. We will settle or defend, as we consider appropriate, any claim or suit asking for these damages. Our duty to settle or defend ends when our limit of liability has been paid.

SECTION 2.2 - Liability Exclusions
Liability Coverage is limited for any vehicle used to carry persons or property for a fee. For purposes of this section: coverage excluded for commercial use.

SECTION 2.3 - Uninsured Motorist Coverage
We will pay compensatory damages which an insured is legally entitled to recover from the owner or operator of an uninsured motor vehicle because of bodily injury sustained by the insured, up to the limit shown in the Declarations.

SECTION 3.1 - Duties After an Accident or Loss
A person seeking coverage must cooperate with us in the investigation and settlement of any claim. In every case the insured must report within 30 days of the accident or loss.

SECTION 3.2 - Collision Coverage
We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision, less the applicable deductible shown in the Declarations. Payment will not exceed the lesser of the actual cash value of the damaged property or the amount necessary to repair or replace it.

SECTION 3.3 - Comprehensive Coverage
We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, including fire, theft, vandalism, flood, and contact with animals, less the applicable deductible shown in the Declarations.

SECTION 3.4 - Rental Reimbursement
If your covered auto is withdrawn from use for more than 24 hours because of a covered loss, we will reimburse transportation expenses up to the daily and maximum amounts shown in the Declarations.

SECTION 4.1 - Policy Territory
Coverage applies only to accidents and losses occurring within the United States, its territories and possessions, or Canada.

SECTION 4.2 - Other Insurance
If there is other applicable insurance, we will pay only our share of the loss. Our share is the proportion that our limit bears to the total of all applicable limits. Any insurance we provide for a vehicle you do not own is excess over any other collectible insurance.

SECTION 5.1 - Cancellation
You may cancel this policy at any time by notifying us. We may cancel by mailing notice to the named insured at the address shown in the Declarations at least 30 days before the effective date of cancellation, or 15 days if cancellation is for nonpayment of premium.

SECTION 5.2 - Fraud and Misrepresentation
We do not provide coverage for any insured who has knowingly concealed or misrepresented any material fact or circumstance in connection with this policy or a claim.

SECTION 5.3 - Changes to This Policy
This policy contains all the agreements between you and us. Its terms may be changed only by an endorsement issued by us.
